raw_metadata.note: Verification-friendly reference: stats mirror the Python reimplementation (scripts/run_risk_parity_backtest.py, lean_statistics=True, risk_free_rate=0.025) because the PDF only provides summary statistics and the framework does not support missing fields. True PDF/LEAN summary stats are stored in pdf_stats; LEAN ground truth in lean_ground_truth. Regenerated 2026-11-13 (branch fix/risk-parity-qc-parity) after three parity fixes found by a trade-by-trade comparison against the Sleepy Tan Coyote run: (1) rebalance decisions use data up to the PREVIOUS close (QC runs at 10:00; the MOC fill is at the day's close) - the old same-day window was a one-day look-ahead that flipped the SMA200 hedge in 2020-03 and 2022-03; (2) rebalancing starts at the backtest start date (the old bar-count warm-up skipped 2016-01..03) and the equity curve starts there; (3) positions are buy-and-hold, so the 2% trade gate compares the DRIFTED holding weight like QC's HoldingsValue/TotalPortfolioValue. Result vs LEAN: return 0.930 vs 0.938, CAGR 7.58% vs 7.62%, max DD -17.85% vs -17.70%, Sharpe 0.351 vs 0.372, daily-return correlation 0.9997, 249/264 order legs identical in (date, symbol, sign). Residual: no fee model (QC $2,698), fractional shares, QC sizes MOC orders at the previous close, yfinance vs QC adjusted prices. Data: yfinance auto_adjust=True, 2015-01-02..2024-12-31 downloaded 2026-11-13 (a superset of the 2015-01-16 start that price_history_start now requests; the extra early bars lie outside every decision window, so results are identical). LEAN statistics conventions: performance = calendar-day equity returns (weekends flat), annual return = (1+daily_mean)^252-1, sample variance; Sharpe/Sortino subtract the average risk-free rate (~2.5%/yr 2016-2024).

pdf_gate.comment: D7: the PDF summary is the parity gate (the top-level stats mirror the reimplementation and can never fail on their own). Wide tolerance: the PDF has no trade list and LEAN differs in methodology/fees/timing.
